text: Shooting is streaky, even for one as good as Klay. This is not enough to make sweeping conclusions about whether his shot is cooked.

Seems worth noting that he shot 38% from 3 last season on almost 8 attempts a game, and the season before that he shot 39% on the same volume. / He’s not the shooter he used to be but he’s still one of the best in the league. He definitely seems more prone to long cold streaks than he was in his prime, but reddit will have you thinking he devolved into Westbrook or something. The reason he’s losing minutes is because he’s a bad defender now and literally the only skill he has left is shooting. He can’t get to the rim at all anymore (and he wasn’t even great at that in his prime) and now that he’s just a spot up guy he doesn’t really get to use his in between game. So when you’re a shooter in a slump who can’t guard anyone, your minutes get cut if your shot isn’t falling.

The past two seasons in Dallas Klay shot in the high 30’s from 3 on volume. Him spacing the floor is going to be integral to Giannis doing his thing offensively. Even if he’s cooked, there’s no way Klay’s man is leaving him to double team Giannis
